pack.bottom_line: Today's tape is materially worse than Tuesday's. The critical numbers are now roughly 10Y 5.13%, 30Y 5.44%, Brent $105 and Nasdaq futures down about 1%. The fresh claims report did nothing to undermine the “strong economy / hawkish Fed” narrative. For today, focus on whether the 10-year can retreat from the 5.14–5.15% area, what comes out of Trump-Xi, and the 1 p.m. 7-year auction. If yields keep climbing despite the equity selloff, that is the signal I would respect most.
pack.playbook_bullish: Bullish reversal: 10Y backs down toward 5.05%, Brent falls below ~$103, Trump-Xi headlines are constructive and NVDA/SMH reclaim VWAP. That combination could generate a strong oversold tech reversal.
pack.playbook_bearish: Bearish continuation: 10Y pushes through ~5.15%, Brent holds $105+, semis fail opening bounces and the 7-year auction is weak. In that setup, I would treat attempts to buy QQQ dips cautiously.
